openNativeCompileAndRuntimeRisks: An actual Xcode build is still required to type-check Swift 6 actor isolation, PhotoKit async changes closures, heterogeneous evidence dictionaries and ImageRenderer/UITraitCollection API binding. No Windows syntax parser can certify these.

Native XCUITest must validate iOS AX aggregation for duplicate member buttons/headers/footers, month row labels, nested series toggles, collage placement labels and StudioMediaPicker date/type labels. Fix capture locators, not production UI, if the runtime differs.

System deletion copy/button exposure is required to be actual en-US SpringBoard with the requested count. The code deliberately has no generic first-button or Allow fallback. A different system UI must fail for inspection.

All three game cards, all five vault cells and the selected duplicate group must really fit the iPhone 17. Bounds checks are implemented, but actual image paint, clipping, overlap and final visual quality remain native visual-QA gates.

The held-swipe capture has a strict real-time completion bound; a slow simctl screenshot after warmup fails rather than accepting a released image. The transient Later capture likewise fails if its unmodified production pill expires before capture.

ImageRenderer must be visually checked on macOS for the original registered font, mechanical dial, private Q tail, correct dark color and transparent-master behavior. Nonzero PNG dimensions alone do not certify logo pixels.

Importing the two byte-identical source files must produce two distinct PhotoKit IDs. The native scan and measured >100 MB video results must pass; missing results cannot be replaced with synthetic groups, estimates or edited captions.
The series capture proves chronological grouping/comparison only. The vault screen proves the exercised UI/import/removal state only; neither is an AI-quality or security/Face ID test.
